keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.lead: AppEndO cannot open remote desktops until Apache Guacamole guacd is running on the machine that hosts this AppEndO process. Probed endpoint: {endpoint}. The Windows PC you want to remote into does not need guacd — only Remote Desktop (port 3389) enabled.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.refresh: After guacd is listening, refresh this page. The warning clears when AppEndO can reach the endpoint.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.title: Windows host
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.intro: Follow this section when AppEndO is installed on Windows. Apache does not ship a native Windows guacd installer — run guacd in Docker on this AppEndO host.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.step1: 1. Install Docker Desktop for Windows and start it. Enable the WSL 2 backend during setup, then wait until Docker reports it is running.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.step2: 2. Open PowerShell and create the container once. This publishes guacd on TCP 4822 on this machine:
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.step3: 3. If that container already exists, start it instead of creating it again:
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.step4: 4. Confirm the container is up and that port 4822 accepts connections:
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.wsl: If you cannot use Docker Desktop, install guacd inside WSL (Ubuntu) on this same PC and keep the service running so Windows can reach 127.0.0.1:4822:
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.commandW:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y guacd
sudo service guacd start
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.windows.env: If the probed endpoint is not 127.0.0.1:4822, set GUACD_HOST and GUACD_PORT in the AppEndO .env to the address Docker or WSL is actually listening on, then restart AppEndO.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.title: Linux host
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.intro: Follow this section when AppEndO is installed on Linux. Install guacd on this AppEndO host only.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.docker: Option A — Docker (any distro). Create the container once; later boots keep it running because of --restart unless-stopped:
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.debian: Option B — Ubuntu / Debian package (no Docker):
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.commandDeb:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y guacd
sudo systemctl enable --now guacd
sudo systemctl status guacd --no-pager
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.verify: Confirm guacd is listening on the probed port:
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.other: Fedora, RHEL, SUSE, and other distros: prefer Docker. If a distro package exists it is usually named guacd or guacamole-server — enable and start that service, then verify port 4822 as above.
keys.rdpHub.guacdUnreachable.linux.env: If the probed endpoint is not 127.0.0.1:4822, set GUACD_HOST and GUACD_PORT in the AppEndO .env to match, then restart AppEndO.
